## Context
With an out-of-worktree `REBAR_TRACKER_DIR` and a code worktree at a commit carrying the ticket trailer, `rebar verify-commit-ticket --rev HEAD` correctly resolved the trailer but CLI `rebar transition ... closed --ref HEAD` falsely reported that no commit referenced the ticket. `close_precheck.py` derived `code_root = os.path.dirname(tracker)`, so a tracker override made it scan the checkout containing tracker storage instead of the current code worktree. The public library call succeeded when passed the actual repo root, proving the defect and workaround.

## Plan
- Add a regression test with a code worktree and a separate custom tracker directory.
- Resolve the code root from the explicit/current repository context while continuing to resolve ticket state from `REBAR_TRACKER_DIR`.
- Preserve the fail-fast no-referencing-commit behavior and default in-repo tracker behavior.
- Run RED to GREEN, defect-seeded mutation, focused lifecycle tests, gates, and Gerrit.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] CLI close with an out-of-worktree `REBAR_TRACKER_DIR` finds a matching trailer reachable from the current code worktree HEAD.
- [x] A true missing referencing commit still fails before the completion LLM call.
- [x] Default in-repo tracker behavior is unchanged.
- [x] The regression test is RED before the fix and GREEN after reintroducing the correct code-root seam.
- [x] Focused tests, lint, typecheck, LLM-Review +1, and Verified +1 pass before merge.
